# Change Log

All notable changes to the "gigacode" extension will be documented in this file.

Check [Keep a Changelog](http://keepachangelog.com/) for recommendations on how to structure this file.

### [1.1.2]

- Add `Gigacode: Update config` to the Command Palette (ctrl+shift+p) which allows
setting a terminal path override and a file path separator override.

## [1.1.1]

- Add support for wsl

## [1.0.0]
